name: Izabela Hamilton
title: Communications specialist and executive coach
bio_short: Communications specialist and ICF certified executive coach with more than 20 years' international experience. Former Jumeirah Group (Burj Al Arab) and Euromonitor International. Founder of InitiativeHub. Teaches at Middlesex University.
bio: Izabela is a communications specialist and ICF certified executive coach with more than 20 years' international experience across Europe, the United States and the Middle East. She is the founder of InitiativeHub, a coaching and communications consultancy, and teaches at Middlesex University. She has managed the communications functions for prominent international brands including Jumeirah Group's flagship Burj Al Arab hotel, market intelligence group Euromonitor International, Incisive Media and Business Monitor International. Her expertise spans developing and managing external and internal communications campaigns, crisis and reputation management, agency relationships, events management and media relations.  Izabela also specialises in career and communication coaching, working with high-performing individuals and future leaders on executive presence, soft skills development and professional communication. Her clients have included professionals at Aramco, King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) and the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons.  At ISOC, Izabela delivers corporate communications, public speaking, executive presence and PR programmes, together with executive coaching. Her experience at the Burj Al Arab, one of the world's most high-profile hospitality brands, gives her a practical understanding of reputation management at the most demanding level. Her career across financial publishing, market intelligence and luxury hospitality gives her breadth that allows her to adapt training to different industries. Izabela is based in Mauritius and trains in English and Polish.
